review.finding: The 20,605-triangle candidate preserves the dense rounded foliage masses, continuous tapered silhouette, planter cylinder, rim and trailing vines instead of V4's long broken-looking spikes.
review.knownLimitation: Leaf microstructure belongs in the dense-donor bake; the starting UV has one zero-length tangent corner that must be repaired or excluded and revalidated after export.
